note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a No provision; A06b No provision; L05 SRI 19(3), 20(5), 21(1)): no ordinary naturalisation by residence; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another (with exceptions). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Sri Lanka, 2024
sources.said: n.a. ... n.a. ... Person is a citizen by descent or registration and voluntarily becomes a citizen of another country. Citizenship will not lapse if declaration is made for retention of citizenship and permission for dual citizenship is granted. This permission may be revoked at a later date.
